test_title: PYST 17: SSC CHSL - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 15 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question:
The following bar graph shows the marks of a student from 5 different subjects in 2015 and 2016. Total marks scored in History for 2016 is what per cent of the total marks of Civics for both years?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dfb0b4ee8b207951ea16caf3e2f3dc29ba9d864bc03c629f4193f2a750cd7e94.png]
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total marks scored in History in 2016 = 40%

Total marks of Civics for both years = 40 + 60 = 100%

Percentage of total marks scored in History for 2016 to the total marks of Civics for both years = 40/100 × 100 = 40%

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
